import sys

sys.path.insert(0, '.codex/skills/docx')

from scripts.document import Document

HEADLINES = [
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
]

doc = Document('unpacked', rsid="5686A7B5")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]

for text in HEADLINES:
    para = editor.get_node(tag="w:p", contains=text)
    if para is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: headline paragraph not found for: {text}")
    found = False
    for run in para.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        ts = run.getElementsByTagName("w:t")
        if ts and ts[0].firstChild and ts[0].firstChild.data.strip() == text:
            rPrs = run.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
            if not rPrs:
                rPr = editor.dom.createElement("w:rPr")
                run.insertBefore(rPr, run.firstChild)
            else:
                rPr = rPrs[0]
            if not rPr.getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
                u = editor.dom.createElement("w:u")
                u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
                rPr.appendChild(u)
            found = True
            break
    if not found:
        raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: no matching run found for headline: {text}")
    print(f"underlined: {text}")

doc.save()
print("saved")
